text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hm, a reply email to the question from 
the other day. "The elementary school's 
flowerbed vegetable garden is part of 
hands-on learning, and the soil is used 
as-is from the flowerbeds."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, flowerbeds and vegetable patches are 
totally different, right?! Even the soil 
changes depending on the kind of 
vegetable!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a school, there're probably all 
kinds of restrictions... but if I'm gonna 
grow 'em, I want these kids to eat some 
genuinely delicious veggies...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, time to negotiate directly with 
the elementary school! I'll go ask if 
they'll let me make their soil!
